ezekiel.16.p1.b1.text: No one cared enough for you to do even one of these things out of compassion for you. Instead, you were thrown out into the open field, because you were despised on the day of your birth.

ezekiel.16.p1.b2.text: Then I passed by and saw you wallowing in your blood, and as you lay there in your blood I said to you, ‘Live!’ There I said to you, ‘Live!’

ezekiel.16.p1.b3.text: I pledged Myself to you, entered into a covenant with you, and you became Mine, declares the Lord GOD.

ezekiel.16.p1.b4.text: Your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, for it was perfect in the splendor I bestowed on you, declares the Lord GOD.

ezekiel.16.p2.b1.text: But because of your fame, you trusted in your beauty and played the harlot.

ezekiel.16.p2.b2.text: You also took the fine jewelry of gold and silver I had given you, and you made male idols with which to prostitute yourself.

ezekiel.16.p2.b3.text: You took your embroidered garments to cover them, and you set My oil and incense before them.

ezekiel.16.p2.b4.text: You slaughtered My children and delivered them up through the fire to idols.

ezekiel.16.p2.b5.text: No one solicited your favors, and you paid a fee instead of receiving one; so you are the very opposite!

ezekiel.16.p2.b6.text: They will level your mounds and tear down your lofty shrines. They will strip off your clothes, take your fine jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.

ezekiel.16.p3.b1.text: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived with her daughters to your north; and your younger sister was Sodom, who lived with her daughters to your south.

ezekiel.16.p3.b2.text: Now this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed, and complacent; they did not help the poor and needy.

ezekiel.16.p3.b3.text: So now you must bear your disgrace, since you have brought justification for your sisters.

ezekiel.16.p3.b4.text: But I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

ezekiel.16.p3.b5.text: so that when I make atonement for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed …
